prompt.alinti: Stop building ugly front ends with Claude.
There are five free repos that literally give it design skills, and here they are.
First, taste skill, built for one thing, killing that AI-generated look.
Next, UI UX Pro Max, 128,000 stars. It gives Claude actual taste, layout, typography, color, everything.
Then, awesome Claude design, 68 pre-built design systems you can drop in, so nothing starts from a blank page.
Number four, design motion principles, layers and animation, transitions, and easing curves so your builds actually move.
The last one is wild, design MD Chrome. Load up any site, click the extension, and boom, you get the entire design system exported.
If you actually wanna go deep on this stuff, I run Claude Code Club, where almost 8,000 of us are learning Claude Code and building and selling real things with it.
So if you want the repo link plus access to the community, check my caption below for the link.
